'''The Alleyway Buffet''' is a power [[Books|book]] that can be obtained by searching a golden garbage can located in the easternmost region of [[Pelican Town]]. There is a hidden opening in the eastern fence, just north of the [[Minecart]] track outside of the [[Blacksmith]]. The player must have at least a steel or better [[Axes|axe]] and [[Pickaxes|pickaxe]] to clear a [[Large Log|large log]] and [[boulder]] blocking the path. The golden garbage can is hidden behind a tree in the clearing at the end of the path. 

It can also be purchased from the [[Bookseller]] for {{Price|20000}} starting in Year 3 (≈9% chance to appear).<ref name="y3chance" />

The first reading grants the player a power that increases their chance to find items in [[Garbage Can]]s by 20%.<ref name="trashpower" /> Once read, it can be found in [[the Player]]'s Menu on the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab. Each subsequent reading gives the player 100 [[Foraging]] [[Skills|XP]].

==Tailoring==
The Alleyway Buffet is not used in any [[tailoring]]. It can be used as a dark gray [[Dyeing|dye]] when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
The Alleyway Buffet is not used in any [[quests]].
